messages.author: 793f7acd19f9941a
messages.subject: Advanced sleep log error
parts:
Hi there, 

I've been trying to use my advanced sleep log as a guider but only have managed with a couple of participants.
This is what I've been running:

  #=====================
library(GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(
  mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
  datadir="W_data",
  outputdir="W_output",
  do.report=c(2,4,5),

  #=====================
  # Part 2
  #=====================
  strategy = 1,
  hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
  maxdur = 9,                 includedaycrit = 16,
  qwindow=c(0,24),
  mvpathreshold =c(100),
  bout.metric = 4,
  excludefirstlast = FALSE,
  includenightcrit = 16,
  #=====================
  # Part 3 + 4
  #=====================
  def.noc.sleep = 1,
  outliers.only = TRUE,
  criterror = 4,
  do.visual = TRUE,
  loglocation=("/Volumes/NO NAME/Week 1_sleep+watch log.csv"), #added
  relyonguider=FALSE, # added
  sleeplogidnum=FALSE, #added
  colid=1, #added
  coln1=4, #added
  nnights=7, #added
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
  boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
  includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("WW"),
  visualreport=TRUE)


And this is the error I get:
  #=====================
 Part 4
Error in sleeplog[cnt, 1] <- as.character(S[j, colid]) :
  replacement has length zero
In addition: Warning message:

None of the IDs in the accelerometer data could be matched with the ID numbers in the sleeplog. You may want to check that the ID format in your sleeplog is consistent with the ID column in the GGIR part2 csv-report, and that arguments coldid and sleeplogidnum are correctly set. 
  #=====================

I've copied and pasted the participant ID from the part 2 csv report, saved and added the sleep log back and still get the same error message.
I've also attached what my sleep log looks like.

Everything else works great and its been such a pleasure to use this package!
Looking forward to hearing your input.

Thanks!
Andrea

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Advanced sleep log error
parts:
Hi Andrea,

Are you sure the sleeplog is in a comma separated file format?  If not, then you can either use GGIR argument sleeplogsep to specify the column sepator, e.g. ',' (default, ';', or '\t'.
Another option would be to convert the sleeplog into a comma seperate file.
I've copied and pasted the participant ID from the part 2 csv report, saved and added the sleep log back and still get the same error message.

Note that GGIR may be sensitive to invisible spaces at the end of a value, e.g. "ID123   " may look like "ID123" in Excel. So make sure you copy the spaces as well, if any.

Best,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/

Another option would be to convert the sleeplog into a comma seperate file.

I've copied and pasted the participant ID from the part 2 csv report, saved and added the sleep log back and still get the same error message.

Note that GGIR may be sensitive to invisible spaces at the end of a value, e.g. "ID123 " may look like "ID123" in Excel. So make sure you copy the spaces as well, if any.
